register.labelZh: BOIL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: BOIL 片語動詞可以清楚表示液體煮乾、溢出鍋外、變得更濃，或被加熱至沸騰。；boil down to 可以直接指出一個選擇或問題最重要的原因或核心。；boil up 可以表示怒氣、恐懼或憂慮在表露出來之前逐漸增強。；boil the sauce down 和 boil the kettle up 等表達能簡潔準確地說明烹調步驟。
register.summaryEn: The BOIL family helps you show whether liquid disappears, spills from a pan, becomes thicker or is heated until it boils. Boil down to lets you state the most important reason or issue directly. Boil up can show anger, fear or worry becoming stronger before it is openly expressed. Expressions such as boil the sauce down and boil the kettle up make cooking steps short and precise.
